chunks: 4051 - And Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from Muhammad ibn Raja' al-Khayyat, who said:

I wrote to al-Tayyib عليه السلام: “I was in al-Masjid al-Haram and saw a dinar. I reached toward it to take it, and then I found another. Then I searched among the pebbles and found a third. So I took them and announced them, but no one identified them. So what do you see regarding that?”

So he عليه السلام wrote: “I have understood what you mentioned regarding the matter of the dinars. If you are in need, then give one-third of them in charity; and if you are wealthy, then give all of them in charity.”

key_terms.الدَّنَانِيرِ: the dinars mentioned in the Imam’s reply
key_terms.الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ: the Sacred Mosque in Makkah, where the property was found
key_terms.دِينَارًا: a gold coin; the found property in question
key_terms.غَنِيًّا: being wealthy and not in need
key_terms.فَعَرَّفْتُهَا: I announced it publicly to identify its owner

ai.seo_question: What should someone do with unclaimed dinars found in al-Masjid al-Haram according to Imam al-Hadi عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning found property in al-Masjid al-Haram after it has been announced and remains unclaimed. The Imam عليه السلام distinguishes between the finder who is in need and the one who is wealthy, directing charity from the found dinars accordingly. It reflects both fiqh on lost property and ethical concern for detachment from doubtful wealth.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4051 - Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from Muhammad ibn Raja' al-Khiyyat, who said:

I wrote to al-Tayyib Imam Ali ibn Muhammad Al-Hadi (as): "I was in the Sacred Mosque (Masjid al-Haram) and saw a dinar. I reached out to take it, and then I found another one. I searched the pebbles and found a third. I took them and announced them, but no one claimed them. What do you advise regarding this matter?"

Imam (as) wrote in reply: "I have understood what you mentioned about the dinars. If you are in need, then give one-third of them in charity. But if you are wealthy, then give all of them in charity."
